name: launchcheck
description: Check a public website before launch for broken links, HTTP failures, missing launch metadata, mobile setup, basic accessibility signals, and security headers.

interface.shortDescription: Check your website before you launch.
interface.longDescription: LaunchCheck runs a bounded, read-only preflight on a public website and returns launch blockers, warnings, passes, checked URLs, and evidence.
defaultPrompt: Check this website before I launch it.
Find launch blockers and broken links on this landing page.
